questions.q: On a normal, non-inverted signal, what level does a UART line sit at when idle?
options: It depends on the baud rate
questions.explain: Idle is logic one, the high level. The start bit pulls the line to zero.

options: A protocol over I2C with a receiver address
questions.explain: SBUS: 100 kbaud, 8 data bits, even parity, 2 stop bits; the inverted signal is part of the protocol's definition, not an exception.

questions.q: Why does CRSF work on any UART of any board?
options: It is an ordinary UART with no inversion
It is slow and needs no buffer
questions.explain: CRSF is standard 8N1 without inversion, full duplex over two wires.

options: SBUS over the CRSF wire without parity
questions.explain: The data is the same; the signal is flipped back to work around the missing inverter on F4.

questions.q: CRSF: channels are there, but the radio shows no telemetry. What do you check?
options: The receiver antenna and the VTX channel
The FC TX → RX wire and half-duplex
questions.explain: Telemetry travels on the return wire. Without it, or in half-duplex, there is none.

questions.q: What CRSF speed does the specification give for full duplex on the aircraft?
questions.explain: TBS specification: 416666 baud 8N1, with the option to negotiate a higher speed.

questions.q: What does the CRC8 in a CRSF frame cover?
questions.explain: The type and the payload, without the sync byte and the length; polynomial 0xD5, per the TBS specification.

questions.q: An SBUS receiver is wired to RX of a free UART on an F4 board without a separate inverter. There is no signal. Why?
questions.fragment:
serial 2 64 115200 57600 0 115200
set serialrx_provider = SBUS
set serialrx_inverted = OFF
options: SBUS is inverted and an F4 UART cannot invert by itself, so you need the input with an inverter
SBUS works only on UART1 because it needs hardware DMA
The speed in the serial command must be 100000, or Betaflight will not open the port
SBUS needs serialrx_inverted = ON on every board, and F4 supports it
questions.explain: On F4 the inversion is done by an external circuit; F7/H7 can invert the UART in software.
